The claim that Anthropic has recently IPOed is supported by multiple current sources. Search results from November 20, 2026 report that Anthropic's stock (ticker: ANT) debuted on Nasdaq with a $1.8 trillion market cap, raised $93.5 billion total including greenshoe overallotment, and saw the stock drop after its first day of trading [E4]. The Guardian reported on Anthropic's second day of trading the same day [E4].

The official Anthropic website (anthropic.com), retrieved on 2026-11-21, displays the ticker symbol "ANT" prominently on its homepage and describes the company as a "Public Benefit Corporation" dedicated to responsible AI development [E6]. The site does not appear to have a dedicated investor relations page, but the presence of the ticker on the homepage is consistent with a public listing.

What remains uncertain: I could not access a dedicated investor relations page or an exchange filing (e.g., Nasdaq listing confirmation or SEC registration) to independently verify the exact listing date, exchange, and share count. The evidence is based on news headlines and the company's own homepage ticker display. The exact IPO date appears to be November 19–20, 2026, based on the "first day" and "second day" reporting, but this is inferred from publication dates rather than a primary exchange notice [E4][E6].
